product_one_liner.value: Sprinto is an autonomous GRC platform that helps fast-scaling SaaS businesses manage compliance, audits, vendor risk and customer trust.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists a Growth plan with contact-sales pricing.

named_customers.notes: Both appear in Sprinto's customer logo wall.

employee_band.notes: Company size listed on Sprinto's LinkedIn profile.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog presents GRC guidance, comparisons and product content, rather than two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building Sprinto.

public_docs.notes: Public developer documentation includes a quick start and a first-API-call guide.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live AI Implementation Intern posting covering AI infrastructure and LLM integration.

model_provider.value: OpenAI (GPT-4 Turbo) and Anthropic (Claude Sonnet and Claude Haiku)

compliance_certs.notes: Sprinto's Trust Center labels these as compliant; GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a formal certification.

last_funding.notes: The funding history updated in October 2026 still lists this as the latest disclosed round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest disclosed round was in April 2024, before the requested window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Enterprise Account Executive – EU posting.

launched_6mo.notes: July–August 2026 product updates announced conversational access to compliance data through ChatGPT and Claude; the announcement was updated October 29, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Karthik Vemparala's profile dates his Sprinto tenure to March 2021–June 2026 and identifies his role as VP, Solutions and Customer Experience, indicating a departure within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Its GTM Engineer posting explicitly identifies HubSpot as the CRM in its internal GTM stack.
